decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the completion of works.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern wall of the roof extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Single storey rear extension and alterations to increase the height of the existing single storey rear addition and incorporate a new roof lights. Demolition of conservatory, new roof extension to increase the size of the existing rear dormer window and erection of roof extension on the existing back addition, plus 2 roof lights to front elevation.
